title: phpMyFAQ through 4.1.12 and from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the…
description: phpMyFAQ versions through 4.1.12 and from 4.2.0-alpha up to but not including 4.2.0-RC.2 have an authorization bypass vulnerability in the admin FAQ copy and translate pages. This flaw allows authenticated users with add-only or category-scoped editor rights to access restricted FAQ content, including drafts, ACL-restricted records, private notes, and author email addresses, by exploiting insufficient permission checks.
